_comment: Guess the Examine: examine lines worth reading out at a quiz night. Items, NPCs and
scenery all belong here; what makes an entry is that the line is funny, not what it
is the examine of. Adding one is the easiest way to contribute to this game.
id       a number that identifies the entry for good: rooms store it as the
answer. Take one more than the highest id here; never change or reuse an id,
name     what the thing is called, as the game writes it. It is the answer, so it
must be distinct from every other name here, ignoring case and accents.
examines one or more examine texts, exactly as the game shows them. Things
that share a name but not an examine -- the eleven Miners of the
Motherlode Mine -- are one entry with a line each: the answer is the
same whichever line is asked. Each line is its own question, and
no line may appear twice in the file, or it would have two answers.
wiki     the OSRS Wiki page for it, or null if there is none. Not shown to
players; kept so assets can be fetched from it later.
Keep the list sorted by name so appends land predictably and rarely conflict.
